name: Google Workspace Marketplace

sources.title: Google Workspace Marketplace — 'Publish apps to the Google Workspace Marketplace' guide (updated 2026-09-03)

requirements: The app must extend at least one Google Workspace application (Gmail, Calendar, Chat, Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, Meet, etc.)
Public apps must comply with Marketplace terms/policies and pass the Marketplace review criteria
A Google Cloud project is required to configure and manage the listing
Public vs private audience must be chosen before publishing — the setting cannot be changed afterwards
preparation: A working app/add-on that extends a Workspace app
OAuth consent configuration (public apps may need a separate OAuth review)
App website URL and logo (required listing assets)
Store listing copy: description, categories, screenshots/icons per the 'Create a store listing' guide
workflow: Create/select a Google Cloud project for the app
Configure OAuth for the app (submit for OAuth review if public and scopes require it)
Test the app against the Marketplace review criteria
Enable the Google Workspace Marketplace SDK and configure visibility, installation settings, and the Workspace apps it extends
Submit for publishing — public apps undergo Google review; private apps go live inside your organization immediately
Monitor publication status; after approval the listing is available to all Marketplace users
watchFor: Public vs private is irrevocable after publishing — decide carefully
App installation settings (admin-only vs all users) affect reach regardless of public/private
Some organizations allowlist apps — listing alone doesn't guarantee installability inside enterprise domains
Publishing is free, but OAuth verification for sensitive/restricted scopes can take days-weeks and is the usual bottleneck
countsAsLive: The app listing page is publicly visible in the Google Workspace Marketplace (workspace.google.com/marketplace) and installable by external users
unknowns: Current average review turnaround for public Marketplace apps (not stated on the fetched page)
Whether the Marketplace listing link to the developer site is dofollow
